title: Totally ordered abelian group
statement: A totally ordered commutative additive group structure on a set $\Gamma$ consists of an addition operation, a zero element, and additive inverses satisfying the abelian-group laws of [def-weil-preadditive-category], together with a relation $\le$ that is reflexive, antisymmetric, transitive, and total, and such that translation preserves order: for all $a,b,c\in\Gamma$, $a\le b$ implies $a+c\le b+c$.
